onboarding.welcome.body.en: Streets, shops and stories are hidden in fog. Walk out and they light up.
onboarding.welcome.body.zh-Hans: 街巷、小店和故事都藏在迷雾里。走出去，它们就会亮起来。

onboarding.welcome.hint.en: Drag the disc to clear the fog

onboarding.roam.body.en: Press GO when you start. The places you pass clear from the map.
onboarding.roam.body.zh-Hans: 出发时按下 GO，走过的地方会在地图上亮起来。

onboarding.roam.demo.hint.en: Press and hold, or double-tap to try it

onboarding.stamps.body.en: Check in at a place to collect its stamp and keep the proof of where you have been.
onboarding.stamps.body.zh-Hans: 到一个地方打卡，就能收集它的印章，留下你来过的证明。

onboarding.clubs.body.en: Join clubs, meet people who walk the same streets and take on events together.
onboarding.clubs.body.zh-Hans: 加入俱乐部，认识走同样街巷的人，一起参加活动。

onboarding.consent.body.en: Create an account to keep your stamps, or look around first as a guest.
onboarding.consent.body.zh-Hans: 创建账号，留住你的印章；也可以先以游客身份逛逛。

onboarding.consent.note.en: Creating an account asks you to review and accept the Terms and Privacy Policy first.
onboarding.consent.note.zh-Hans: 创建账号前，会先请你查看并同意服务条款和隐私政策。
